subject: Unable to reset my password
body:

Rahul

I’m currently using the free version, but I’m also facing issues with login
verification emails not arriving.
At the same time, I wanted to understand whether your premium plans support
multiple users.
Please advise.
Regards,
Sanjay

They also ask about premium plan features (multi-user support), which is a lead signal. The login issue is the more urgent/actionable problem blocking their use of the product, so support is the primary intent, though the pricing inquiry lowers confidence.
